violations.title: Truncated Y-axis
violations.explanation: The vertical axis starts at 95 instead of 0, exaggerating growth visually.

violations.title: No confidence intervals
violations.explanation: Point estimates are shown without uncertainty bands or sample sizes.

violations.title: Cherry-picked time range
violations.explanation: The visible window omits a prior downturn that reverses the narrative.

violations.title: Missing historical context
violations.explanation: Full series includes volatility not shown in the highlighted window.

violations.title: Simpson's paradox
violations.explanation: Overall trend is positive while every subgroup trend is negative.

violations.title: Dual-axis scale manipulation
violations.explanation: Independent left/right scales are tuned to make unrelated series appear correlated.

violations.title: Implied causation
violations.explanation: Overlay suggests one metric drives the other without statistical test.

violations.title: Opaque index rebasing
violations.explanation: Series rebased to 100 without showing the pre-index level or formula.

audits.title: Unlabeled log scale
audits.description: Log curve presented as linear growth

violations.title: Log scale not disclosed
violations.explanation: Logarithmic axis makes modest early changes look like explosive linear growth.

violations.title: Underpowered sample
violations.explanation: Only four observations per series; trend line overstates certainty.
